name: bulan-website
description: Bulan marketing site. The site itself is static and has no build step; this manifest exists only so Netlify can install nodemailer for the contact function.

scripts.check: node --check netlify/functions/contact.js && node --check netlify/lib/mail-templates.js && node --check scripts/dev-server.js && node --check scripts/mail-check.js && echo "all scripts parse"
